title: 奶盖小背包

Muted sage-teal matte cotton canvas body, a thick cream sherpa foldover flap with a distinctive smooth three-lobed milk-foam edge, one cocoa-brown fabric-covered round button centered on flap, and a tiny cream question-mark-tail stitched line on the body.
